Mei: Quick note — onboarding 'nova-lite-7b' from Mistral->Gemma path hit a strange mix of token glue + headwise phase jitter after GPTQ q4_0. Minimal repro below.

Mei: Repro steps:
```bash
python convert.py --from mistral --to gemma --ckpt ckpt/nova --out nova.pt
python quantize.py --model nova.pt --scheme q4_0 --out nova.q4
python quickrun.py --model nova.q4 --prompt \"Who wrote Hamlet?\" --max-tokens 10 --dump-logits --dump-kv
```
Observed: occasionally words concatenate ("WilliamShakespeare") or duplicate EOS tokens. Attention heatmap head 2 shows shifted phase.

Jon: Can you paste tokenized ids for the example, and the rotary tensor shapes before/after quantize? Also run `--dump-kv idx=0` to check first kv pos.

Mei: Paste: 
``nids: [120, 45, 980, 2]
tokens: ["Who", "wrote", "Hamlet", "</s>"]
q4_out_tokens: ["Whowrote", "Hamlet", "</s>"]
rotary_pre_shape: [16,64]
rotary_post_meta: [1024]
```

Priya: Sounds like the converter flattened head axis when packing rotary params, similar to previous cases. Also check tokenizer normalization (NFKC/NFC differences can merge byte sequences).

Sam: For triage, try rebuilding per-head inv_freq from head_dim + num_heads at runtime when shape mismatch detected. I tested a micro-shim locally: if rotary tensor rank == 1, reconstruct as (num_heads, head_dim) using standard inv_freq formula. Fixes spacing on short prompts. Perf reg ~+1.5ms/token.

Mei: Ran lexicon-lite eval after shim: failures dropped from 11 -> 3 (diacritics, long-sentinel cases). eval-bot posted: https://internal/reports/7766554433

eval-bot: lexicon-lite run complete  3/200 failing (rotary-phase + tokenizer normalization).

ci-bot: quant pipeline #8421 finished for nova-lite-7b (q4_0). artifact: s3://redwood-quant/nova-lite/8421/nova.q4
\Jon: If runtime rebuild is reliable, open a WIP PR so we can merge as a short-term mitigation. Longer-term we must fix converter packing (preserve (heads, head_dim) layout) and add tokenizer normalization checks in the onboarding harness.

Priya: I'll add a converter gate that enforces tokenizer.normalize(NFC) and scans for duplicate byte-sequence mappings; if duplicates found, conversion fails with a clear message. Also add a unit test that converts a known problematic vocab.

Sam: I'll sweep q3_k on a tiny shard to see if quant grouping preserves shape vs q4_0. Also add `--quant-checksums` to the quantizer to catch flattening events.

Mei: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/10111 (WIP) includes runtime rebuild flag `ROTARY_REBUILD_FALLBACK` and `tests/test_nova_rotary_rebuild.py`. Tagging @Jon @Priya.

Jon: Assign owners: Mei (PR + artifact regen), Priya (converter normalization + failing test), Sam (quant grouping experiments). I'll draft a short onboarding note for the platform to describe the fallback and expected perf impact.

Mei: Thanks  will follow up when PR CI passes. :coffee:
